title: "Steroid users don't hurt anyone" LIES
summary: NH rebuts the argument that steroid-using fitness influencers hurt no one. A private enhanced lifter is free to choose, but influencers who sell programs and supplements built on a drug-made physique while claiming to be natural damage their followers' trust and self-belief. Naturals should build their own communities and ignore the noise.
claims: A private lifter or pro bodybuilder who chooses steroids without influencing anyone is free to do so
The 'their body their choice' defence fails for fitness influencers because they sell supplements and programs off a drug-built physique
Widespread distrust and 'natty or not' videos exist because almost everyone has been betrayed by a fake natural they followed
Discovering an idol was on steroids shatters trust in yourself, pushing you to either take drugs or believe you'll stay small forever
Fans who keep defending exposed fake naturals show Stockholm syndrome and sunk-cost thinking
Fake naturals or people claiming TRT have become normalised in fitness YouTube, like corrupt politicians
Influencers who start steroids to profit are running a premeditated cycle of lies
Advice from someone on steroids won't work for natural lifters
The endless supply of gullible beginners means fake naturals keep being replaced, and call-outs feed them drama rather than destroying them
Natural lifters should build their own spaces, work on themselves and ignore the noise
